description: Hand-authored causal risk DAG for the five SMADP risk axes. Edges encode how one realized risk plausibly amplifies a downstream risk when two agents are composed. Deterministically consumed by smadp.analyzer.causality and mirrored in site/src/lib/causality.ts (cross-language parity enforced by identical golden tests). Nothing here is LLM-derived; severities come from verdicts, the structure is fixed.

edges.mechanism: An injected instruction redirects an agent to read and emit data it would not otherwise disclose, turning prompt injection into exfiltration.
Injected control flow makes one agent act on adversarial input, propagating a faulty action into the partner's task chain.
Leaked regulated data (PII, secrets) is itself a reportable compliance breach for the deploying organization.
Overlapping or contradictory capabilities cause one agent to undo or corrupt the other's work, cascading into a broader task failure.
An uncontained cascading failure can breach availability, integrity, or record-keeping obligations the deployment is held to.
